mapsNote: Add a Google Maps JavaScript API key (restricted to your domain) to use Google Maps; without one the schematic map is shown. The artifact preview always shows the schematic because its sandbox blocks Google scripts.

auth.note: Host accounts require a backend: Supabase Auth (or Firebase/Clerk) with Google and Apple providers. The static preview shows the flow only.

payments.note: Bookings placed on Northern Notch are charged through Stripe Connect; the 3% application fee is deducted automatically and the balance is paid to the host's connected account. Bookings a host takes elsewhere owe nothing.

platformFee.note: Optional flat monthly platform fee; 0 while the network is small.
